decision.summary: A sustained E-axis offset (~615–655) is evident in original data: E drops from ~-5.5 to ~-7.5 MAD and remains low through 655; U dips concurrently but less consistently; N shows no clear monotonic trend. The return phase is incomplete/ambiguous—E recovers partially near 660–665 but does not clearly revert to pre-offset baseline before end of allowed context (705), and missing samples around 666–672 prevent confirmation. No other temporary offsets are supported by the full original series within [570,705].

intervals.observation: E-component shows a sustained downward shift from index ~615 to ~655; U shows a weaker coherent dip, N fluctuates. Return is ambiguous near 660–665 and not fully observed within allowed context (ends at 705).
